description: This file defines a class 'Builder' for creating various types of matrices, such as filled matrices and identity matrices, in the 'Matrix' namespace.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to generate different types of matrices, such as filled matrices and identity matrices.

methods.name: createFilledMatrix
methods.description: Creates a new matrix filled with a specified value, with optional columns parameter defaulting to a square matrix if not provided.

methods.name: createIdentityMatrix
methods.description: Creates a square identity matrix of specified dimensions, optionally allowing a custom fill value for non-diagonal entries.
